design.jobs: C3: C at plus3, 10 targets x seeds 12750101, 12750102 = 20 (headline); C1: C at plus1, 10 x seed 12750101 = 10; T3: T at plus3, 10 x 2 = 20; 50 jobs. Smoke seed 12750301 (SJ, KR; C1 and T3) not gated
design.memory: RLIMIT_AS = 2.0 GiB per job child; oom_score_adj 1000; MemoryError/signal -> KILL. 3 workers
design.time: SIGKILL at 900 s per job -> KILL (was 420 s in 074); main cap 4800 s (was 3300); main run once

diagnostic_not_gated: per-target kill reasons and step counts at C3 vs study 074; wall times with short traces

gates.GBASE75: all 20 T3 records present and recounted; C/T table written
gates.GC1_75: arm C at tight N (C1) decided on at least 7 of 10 targets, 0 WRONG
gates.GFID75: every non-KILL record's actions replay to the recorded readings on one fresh decoder
gates.GHEAD75: HEADLINE: arm C at loose N (C3) decided (IDF, recounted correct) on at least 6 of 20 cells, covering at least 3 different targets, 0 WRONG
gates.GHELD75: at least 1 of 4 held-out C3 cells (HZ, JO x 2) decided, 0 WRONG
gates.GHOST75: git diff v0.70.0..run_start -- brute is empty (no new brute/ file; same certify/34h)
gates.GLIVE75: main complete within main_cap+60s; RESULTS matches SEAL; all 50 jobs present
gates.GMEM75: every record has rlimit_as_bytes and workers as designed; kill reasons recorded
gates.GNORESET75: adapter AST ok; every non-KILL record has decoder_objects=1 and resets=0
gates.GS75_sound: 0 WRONG / 0 TRACE_MISMATCH on all recounted records
gates.GSTEP75: over C3 cells where C and T3 both decided, median C/T decoder steps <= 1.0
gates.GTEST75: official TEST_SUITE_075 passed; gated test file hashes match
gates.GTRUTH75: truth_075 ledger matches file; make_truth_075 --check ok

honest_framing: v0.70.0 certify/34h dropped the homing batch; at N=true+3 it decided 5/20 cells (KR×2, B5×2, HK×1), 0 wrong; 0 memory_cap and 15 timeout at 420 s. Tight N 8/10. GHEAD short by 1 cell; held-out 0/4. Decided cells finished in ~66–310 s. This version keeps the same API and raises the per-job kill 420->900 s (MAIN_CAP 3300->4800) to test whether the timeout wall, not the algorithm, was what stopped the remaining cells.

pre_plan_exploration.consequence: Gate thresholds stay at 6 of 20 cells / 3 targets (same as 073/074). Main seeds are 12750101 and 12750102 (new).
pre_plan_exploration.diagnosis: Study 074 C3 kills: 15/15 remaining were timeout at 420 s, 0 memory_cap. Versus 073: cells 3→5, targets 2→3, memory_cap 14→0, timeout 3→15. SJ both seeds were IDF under certify/33h (with batch) in 073 but timeout under certify/34h in 074 — batch removal traded SJ for B5/HK gains. Decided 074 cells: KR 744 steps, B5/HK 940 steps.
pre_plan_exploration.fix_check: Ungated certify/34h time-raise pilot (disclosed): see plan note /tmp/s75/pilot if present; otherwise extrapolation from 074 wall times only, with no Brute arm on 075 gate seeds 12750101/12750102 before freeze except ungated smoke after freeze.

process: LEAN: plan locked before gated data, one main run, exact recount, failures published, one fresh-clone check, no CI, no drills, no host-pause probe
question: With the same certify/34h API and the per-job kill raised from 420 s to 900 s (MAIN_CAP 4800 s), how many real decoders does Brute decide reset-free at a LOOSE declared N (true+3), soundly, and does tight-N hold?
status_rule: CERTIFIED iff every gate passes; else not certified with failing gates listed
target_software: CPython 3.13.5 incremental decoders via public interface only, no resets
truth: experiments/truth_075.json (same oracle machines as truth_074; new schema tag)
what_this_cannot_show: No noise; sizes 3-10 states; N=true+3 uses oracle sizes; two seeds; 2.0 GiB and 900 s are runner caps; guarantee conditional on N and clean readings; raising time does not prove an algorithmic gain
